nodes.description: Ownable._owner: address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender at construction and changed by transferOwnership/renounceOwnership.
SBFTweetsRebase._totalSupply: total fragment supply, mutated by rebase() and initialized to INITIAL_FRAGMENTS_SUPPLY.
_gonsPerFragment: gon exchange rate used by balanceOf/transfer/transferFrom, recomputed on every rebase().
mapping(address => uint256) _gonBalances: internal gon balances of every holder.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _allowedFragments: ERC20 allowance table.
MAX_SUPPLY constant (~uint128(0)) used to clamp _totalSupply after a rebase.
TOTAL_GONS constant: total gon supply minted to the owner at construction.
INITIAL_FRAGMENTS_SUPPLY constant (100000 * 10**18) used as the initial fragment supply.
rebase(uint256 epoch, uint256 supplyDelta) external onlyOwner: mutates total supply and the gon rate, clamping supply to MAX_SUPPLY.
SBFTweetsRebase constructor: sets _owner, initial supply, gon balances and gon rate.
transfer(address to, uint256 value) public validRecipient: moves gon balances of msg.sender to 'to'.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) public validRecipient: spends allowance and moves gon balances.
approve(address spender, uint256 value) public: overwrites the caller's allowance entry.
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public: adds to the caller's allowance entry.
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public: subtracts from the caller's allowance entry with a zero floor.
balanceOf(address who) public view: returns _gonBalances[who] divided by _gonsPerFragment.
totalSupply() public view: returns _totalSupply.
allowance(address owner_, address spender) public view: returns the _allowedFragments entry.
Ownable constructor: sets _owner = msg.sender and emits OwnershipTransferred.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner: rewrites _owner after a zero-address check.
renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner: sets _owner to address(0), permanently disabling owner-only functions.
owner() public view: returns _owner.
onlyOwner modifier: require(_owner == msg.sender) guard applied to rebase, transferOwnership and renounceOwnership.
validRecipient modifier: rejects the zero address and the token contract itself as recipient.
SafeMath.add: overflow-checked addition used for supply and balance updates.
SafeMath.sub: underflow-checked subtraction used for balance and allowance updates.
SafeMath.mul: overflow-checked multiplication used to convert fragments into gons.
SafeMath.div: division with a division-by-zero check used to compute the gon rate.
SafeMath.mod: modulo with a modulo-by-zero check (unused by the token logic).
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowances.
rebase: _totalSupply = _totalSupply.add(supplyDelta) inflates/deflates the whole supply at the owner's discretion.
rebase: _gonsPerFragment = TOTAL_GONS.div(_totalSupply) can divide by zero if _totalSupply is driven to 0.
transfer: value.mul(_gonsPerFragment) converts a fragment amount into gons; the rate is owner-manipulable via rebase.
transfer: _gonBalances[msg.sender].sub(gonValue) debits the caller without any allowance check.
transferFrom: decrements _allowedFragments[from][msg.sender] by the raw value rather than by gonAmount.
transferFrom: _gonBalances[from].sub(gonValue) debits 'from' after the allowance check; rate changes can make it fail.
approve: _allowedFragments[msg.sender][spender] = value overwrites the allowance (classic approve race condition).
increaseAllowance: unbounded addition to the caller's allowance entry.
decreaseAllowance: oldValue.sub(subtractedValue) with a zero-floor branch.
Ownable/SBFTweetsRebase constructor: _owner = msg.sender grants unrestricted owner privileges to the deployer.
onlyOwner: require(_owner == msg.sender) is the sole access control protecting rebase.
SBFTweetsRebase constructor: _gonBalances[_owner] = TOTAL_GONS mints the whole gon supply to the owner.
epoch: rebase epoch number, only logged in the LogRebase event.
supplyDelta: caller-supplied change applied to _totalSupply in rebase.
to: recipient address of transfer, validated by validRecipient.
value: fragment amount moved by transfer.
from: address whose balance and allowance are spent in transferFrom.
to: recipient address of transferFrom, validated by validRecipient.
value: fragment amount moved by transferFrom.
spender: address granted an allowance in approve.
value: allowance amount written in approve.
spender: address whose allowance is increased.
addedValue: amount added to the caller's allowance entry.
spender: address whose allowance is decreased.
subtractedValue: amount removed from the caller's allowance entry.
who: address queried by balanceOf.
newOwner: address that becomes _owner in transferOwnership.
owner_: allowance owner queried by allowance.
spender: allowance spender queried by allowance.
gonValue: value.mul(_gonsPerFragment) computed inside transfer.
gonValue: value.mul(_gonsPerFragment) computed inside transferFrom.
oldValue: cached allowance read at the start of decreaseAllowance.
to: recipient address checked by the validRecipient modifier.
